title: Approximate Quantile Factor Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.33461v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Weakly dependent idiosyncratic errors are standard in mean factor models, but quantile factor models have been analyzed only under independence. The mean-case definition of weak dependence, a bound on the eigenvalues of the error covariance matrix, does not carry over: I show that it neither implies nor is implied by the property that controls quantile estimation, since uncorrelated errors can share a pervasive quantile component. I instead define approximate quantile factor models through a concentration condition on the idiosyncratic array. Under it, the quantile factor analysis (QFA) estimator is consistent at a rate that deteriorates by the square root of a dependence constant, which is minimax optimal, and the number of factors is consistently estimated. translated_abstract: 在均值因子模型中，弱相关的个体特异性误差是标准假设，但分位数因子模型此前仅在独立性假设下得到分析。均值情形下弱相依的定义——即误差协方差矩阵特征值的界——并不能直接沿用：我证明它既不蕴含也不被控制分位数估计的性质所蕴含，因为不相关的误差可能共享一个普遍存在的分位数成分。因此，我通过对个体特异性阵列施加集中性条件来定义近似分位数因子模型。在该条件下，分位数因子分析（QFA）估计量仍保持一致性，但其收敛速率以相依常数的平方根倍恶化，且该速率是极小极大最优的；因子个数也能被一致估计。相依性会改变渐近方差，为此我提供了HAC估计量和阈值化估计量。蒙特卡洛实验证实了这些理论预测。在FRED-QD和FRED-MD数据集中，标准的……
tldr: 本文提出以集中性条件定义的近似分位数因子模型，证明在弱相依误差下QFA估计量仍以极小极大最优速率一致，因子个数可一致估计，并针对相依性改变的渐近方差给出HAC和阈值化估计量。
en_tdlr: This paper defines approximate quantile factor models via a concentration condition on idiosyncratic errors, proving the QFA estimator remains consistent at a minimax-optimal rate under weak dependence, with HAC and thresholded estimators proposed for the altered asymptotic variance.
